des interfaces modernes, performantes et responsives avec Next.js, React et TypeScript. \- Participer à la conception et à l’évolution d’une architecture microservices. \- Développer des services fiables communiquant notamment avec RabbitMQ. \- Travailler avec PostgreSQL pour la modélisation des données, les requêtes, les migrations et l’optimisation des performances. \- Utiliser Redis pour le cache, les données temporaires, les quotas, la synchronisation et les besoins liés aux systèmes distribués. \- Développer des fonctionnalités SaaS telles que la gestion des utilisateurs, de sécurité. \- Participer à la mise en place et à l’amélioration des pipelines CI/CD. \- Travailler avec Docker et Kubernetes. \- Participer aux déploiements et à l’exploitation des services dans le cloud. \- Participer à l’amélioration de l’observabilité, du monitoring et de la résilience des services. \- Utiliser Git et les bonnes pratiques de gestion de versions, branches, pull requests et At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak\-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

  

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

#### **Bombardier’s Benefits Program**

  

With our employees’ well\-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:

* Insurance plans *(Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)*
* Competitive base salary
* Retirement savings plan
* Employee Assistance Program
* Tele Health Program

### **What are your contributions to the team?**

* Own Ariba catalog operations end to end, including catalog intake, enablement, maintenance, issue resolution, supplier coordination, content quality, user adoption, and continuous improvement of buying channels.
* Improve procurement operations by streamlining procure\-to\-pay workflows, clarifying handoffs, resolving operational bottlenecks, and standardizing processes that support compliant and efficient purchasing.
* Monitor procurement operations and catalog performance using SAP, Ariba, and Power BI, including adoption, touchless transaction rates, exception trends, cycle times, and compliance indicators, and translate insights into actions for stakeholders and leadership.
* Support supplier collaboration by coordinating catalog onboarding requirements, maintaining supplier content quality, preparing user documentation, and providing training or support that improves catalog adoption and procurement transparency.
* Support S/4HANA deployment for future sites by helping define procurement requirements, validating process readiness, coordinating testing and training inputs, supporting issue resolution, and ensuring catalog and procurement operations are aligned with the global template.
### **How to thrive in this role?**

* You have a Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Management, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field.
* You have a minimum of three (3\) years of experience in procurement operations, procure\-to\-pay processes, catalog management, continuous improvement, or data\-driven supply chain roles. Additional years of experience preferred.
* You have experience coordinating projects, tracking milestones, managing dependencies, and following up with cross\-functional stakeholders; PMP certification is an asset.
* You have change management experience, including user readiness, adoption support, impact communication, and transition planning.
* You are familiar with SAP Ariba, preferably with hands\-on experience in Catalog, Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Guided Buying, or supplier enablement.
* You have exposure to SAP S/4HANA or a strong interest in learning ERP tools.
* You have strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel; experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools is an asset.
* You can work effectively in both English and French, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.
* You are organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage priorities, resolve issues, coordinate stakeholders, and drive actions to closure.
* You are adaptable, collaborative, and able to build strong working relationships.
**Now that you can see yourself in this role, apply and join the Bombardier Team!**

  

Please note: You don’t need *all* the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.  

  

Bombardier is an equal opportunity employer and encourages persons of any race, religion, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, immigration status, disability or other applicable legally protected characteristics to apply.

* Strong Power Automate experience designing workflow automation.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis skills.
* Experience in manufacturing, distribution, or supply chain environments.

* Experience with SQL, Dataverse, or Azure data platforms.
* Experience implementing ERP enhancements or digital transformation projects.
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM or CSCP) considered an asset.

* Group insurance and RRSP with employer contribution
* 24/7 telemedicine and Employee Assistance Program
* Training and career development opportunities

* Employee recognition programs

The Business Analyst (BA) plays a central role in transforming our Project Management Office into a “PMO as a Service” model. Acting as a true bridge builder, he/she does not merely document requests: he/she listens, questions, and analyzes the real challenges faced by business units in order to translate them into solutions that generate measurable value. In a constantly evolving market, the BA actively leverages new technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), to optimize processes. He/she ensures perfect alignment between business vision and technical execution by working in close collaboration with the Practice Lead, Functional Analyst, and BI Developer, thereby ensuring that the PMO solves the right problems for the right internal clients.  



**Your future duties and responsibilities**


. Consultation and requirements gathering: Act as a strategic partner to business units to understand their pain points. Gather real needs by probing beyond the initial requests and structure this information into clear and actionable specifications.  

. Value and performance definition (OKR/KPI): Require and quantify the business value of each initiative before its launch. Collaborate with management and internal clients to define, implement, and monitor Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) as well as Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) measuring project success and PMO effectiveness.  

. Innovation and efficiency: Proactively identify opportunities to integrate solutions based on new technologies in order to automate low value added tasks, optimize business processes, and increase overall efficiency.  

. Process modeling and optimization: Map current state business processes (As Is) and design target state processes (To Be) by eliminating bottlenecks, while positioning the PMO service catalog as a business solution.  

. Operational synergy and alignment: Orchestrate the translation of business needs to the internal team: validate the methodological approach with the Practice Lead, structure data requirements with the BI Developer, and provide precise requirements to the Functional Analyst for system configuration.  

  



**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Qualifications \& Skills  

  

. Influential and strategic leadership: Ability to position the PMO as a value added service provider, influence stakeholders without formal authority, and actively support organizational change.  

. Critical and analytical thinking: Ability to challenge the status quo, identify the root cause of business problems, and support recommendations with evidence based data.  

. Technological curiosity and innovation: Strong interest in the evolution of emerging technologies (including AI) and a general understanding of their potential applications to optimize business processes, without requiring deep technical expertise.  

. Communication excellence: Superior ability to act as a translator between complex technical concepts and strategic business issues, thereby facilitating shared understanding during workshops and working sessions.  

. Business analysis expertise: Ability to map processes, write clear requirements, and build compelling Business Cases.  

. Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related discipline. A business analysis certification (e.g., CBAP, PMI PBA) is considered an asset.  

. Years of experience: A minimum of 5 to 8 years of experience as a Business Analyst, ideally in an organizational transformation context or within a PMO.  

. Proficiency with daily tools: Process modeling tools (Visio, Lucidchart), project management tools (Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence), and familiarity with data analysis concepts.  

. Language requirements: The role requires daily interaction with French speaking and English speaking stakeholders. Full bilingual proficiency (spoken and written) is required.

At EDC, we support Canadian businesses to succeed globally. We provide the financial tools and expertise they need to explore new markets, reduce risks, all towards the goal of making Canada and the world better through trade.

**Employment Type:** Permanent

 **Compensation Details:*** Business Analyst 17: Salaries typically range from $84,698 to $112,931 annually, based on qualifications and experiences, plus a performance\-based incentive.

**Location:*** Export Development Canada operates in a hybrid work environment, with a current requirement of three days per week (subject to change).

**About EDC:**
At Export Development Canada (EDC), we empower Canadian businesses to succeed globally. As a financial Crown corporation, we offer innovative financial solutions and expert insights to help businesses explore new markets, mitigate risks, and achieve growth.

**Why Join EDC?*** **Comprehensive Benefits:** EDC offers a competitive compensation \& benefits package, work\-life balance, \& the opportunity to help make Canada and the world better through trade.
* **Work\-Life Balance:** EDC offers a competitive compensation package \& work\-life balance. We have hybrid work options, 3 to 4 weeks paid vacation, a corporate closure period, summer early Friday’s \& no meeting Fridays.
* **Professional Development:** Take advantage of our continuous learning opportunities, including training programs, workshops and language training.
* **Inclusive Culture:** Be part of a diverse and inclusive workplace that champions employment equity \& values diversity of ideas, strengths, \& backgrounds to succeed.
* **Wellness Programs:** Access to wellness initiatives, mental health support, and fitness programs to keep you healthy and happy.
* **Community Engagement:** Participate in volunteer opportunities and give back to the community through our various social responsibility programs.

**Team Overview:**
The Digital \& Technology Solutions (DTS) group under the leadership of the Chief Information Officer was established in 2023 with the mission of empowering our customers and colleagues to take on the world, by seamlessly delivering secure and reliable digital experiences. Digital \& Technology Solutions has set out to achieve the following objectives for EDC:

* Define, execute, and sustain the integrated technology target state, target data model and technology operations required to enable EDC’s 2030 business transformation.
* Establish and manage the rolling 3 Year Digital Roadmap that sequences the technology outcomes required to achieve the technology target state and facilitate its execution across all domains in the organization.
* Keep pace with industry trends and emerging technologies, ensuring EDC has access to the digital technology tools it needs to stay relevant in the market and grow Canadian global trade.
* Lead and ensure integrated digital, data, infrastructure, and cybersecurity implementations to create excellent customer, user, and employee experiences.

**What you will be doing:**
The Business Analyst supports Delivery Families and Technology Teams working within the Digital Technology Solutions (DTS) group, with a focus on Risk \& Corporate Services (RCS).


The Business Analyst is responsible for enabling effective delivery outcomes by eliciting, analyzing, and validating business requirements, ensuring alignment between business needs, data, and technology solutions. The role partners closely with product owners, delivery teams, and stakeholders to support backlog refinement, solution design, and delivery execution within an Agile environment.


The objective of this role is to ensure that business needs are clearly understood, requirements are complete and actionable, and solutions delivered meet expected outcomes. This includes supporting decision\-making through structured analysis, identifying risks and dependencies, and ensuring data and process integrity across impacted systems.


In addition, the Business Analyst plays a key role in an increasingly AI\-assisted delivery environment by validating analytical outputs and ensuring insights generated through data and automation are accurate, explainable, and aligned with business and risk requirements. The role emphasizes critical thinking, judgment, and interpretation to support high\-quality decision\-making.


The Business Analyst is also an active contributing member of the Business Analysis and delivery community, working collaboratively to share knowledge, improve practices, and drive consistency and continuous improvement across initiatives.

**Key responsibilities:**

**The Opportunity**


As a Data Analytics and Reporting Analyst on the go.transform team, you will help turn data into actionable insights that inform transformation decisions, measure adoption and business impact, identify opportunities for improvement, and support the successful scaling of new tools, processes, and ways of working across the Firm

**About the Team**


The go.transform team leads Egon Zehnder’s firm\-wide transformation agenda, partnering across functions to design, implement, and scale new ways of working. The team focuses on driving adoption of strategic initiatives, leveraging data and insights to track progress, measure impact, and support continuous improvement. Current priorities include AI and Copilot enablement, workflow optimization, knowledge management, and broader business transformation efforts. The team works closely with business stakeholders to translate strategy into practical, measurable outcomes that enhance productivity, collaboration, and client impact.

**What You'll Do**

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Conduct deep\-dive analyses to support go.transform decision\-making and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Analyze colleague experience, behavioral adoption metrics, and application usage data.
* Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, automated reporting, and performance monitoring solutions.
* Measure program impact, digital adoption, and colleague sentiment across key initiatives.
* Develop executive\-ready insights, reporting, and communications for leadership across platforms including Power BI, SharePoint, Workday, and Microsoft 365\.

  

**Requirements**  

* 2\-5 years of experience in analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or a related field within a global organization.
* Proven experience designing, building, and managing reporting and analytics workstreams.
* Strong analytical, reporting, visualization, and user research capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in Power BI and Excel.
* Experience working with global teams and stakeholders across multiple functions and organizational levels.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Key Skills \& Capabilities**

**Technical**

* Advanced Excel, including Power Query and complex data modelling
* Power BI, including DAX, data modelling, dashboard design, and report deployment
* Data wrangling, cleansing, and transformation
* SQL for data extraction and analysis
* Power Automate for workflow and reporting automation
* Python for analytics, automation, and data processing
* Reporting automation and process optimization
* Data visualization and storytelling

**Business \& Stakeholder**

* Executive reporting and presentation development
* Requirements gathering and stakeholder management
* Digital adoption and behavioral analytics
* Colleague experience and survey analysis
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking
* Ability to translate complex data into actionable, executive\-level insights and recommendations

**Desirable**

* VBA / Macros for legacy Excel automation
* Experience with SharePoint, Workday, and Microsoft 365 reporting ecosystems
* Familiarity with APIs and data integrations

Egon Zehnder is the world’s preeminent leadership advisory firm, inspiring leaders to navigate complex questions with human answers. We help organizations get to the heart of their leadership challenges and offer honest feedback and insights to help leaders realize their true being and purpose.


We are built on a foundation that supports partnership in the truest sense of the word and aligns our interests with the interests of our clients. Our 560 consultants across 64 offices and 36 countries are former industry and functional leaders who collaborate seamlessly across geographies, industries and functions to deliver the full power of the Firm to every client, every time.


We partner closely with public and private corporations, family\-owned enterprises, and non\-profit and government agencies to provide executive search, leadership solutions, CEO search and succession, and board advisory.


We believe that together we can transform people, organizations and the world through leadership.

Only those applicants who align most closely with our minimum and preferred qualifications will be contacted for an interview. The Recruiting team at Egon Zehnder will retain your application materials and may contact you regarding future opportunities.*

En tant qu’analyste en analyse de données et en production de rapports au sein de l’équipe go.transform, vous contribuerez à transformer les données en informations exploitables qui éclaireront les décisions de transformation, permettront de mesurer l’adoption et l’impact sur les affaires, d’identifier les possibilités d’amélioration et de soutenir la mise en œuvre à grande échelle de nouveaux outils, processus et modes de travail à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

L’équipe go.transform dirige le programme de transformation à l’échelle de l’entreprise d’Egon Zehnder, en collaborant avec toutes les fonctions pour concevoir, mettre en œuvre et déployer à grande échelle de nouveaux modes de travail. L’équipe s’attache à favoriser l’adoption d’initiatives stratégiques, en tirant parti des données et des informations pour suivre les progrès, mesurer l’impact et soutenir l’amélioration continue. Les priorités actuelles comprennent la mise en œuvre de l’IA et de Copilot, l’optimisation des flux de travail, la gestion des connaissances et des efforts plus larges de transformation de l’entreprise. L’équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants opérationnels afin de traduire la stratégie en résultats concrets et mesurables qui améliorent la productivité, la collaboration et l’impact auprès des clients.

Pratt \& Whitney Canada (P\&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928\. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale.

Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.

 **Un employeur de choix**


Pratt \& Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale.

 **Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe ?**


Le candidat sélectionné devra coordonner des plans d’action, gérer des projets et mettre en œuvre des stratégies à travers plusieurs fonctions et équipes. Ce poste offre une occasion unique de contribuer à la livraison des moteurs au sein de Pratt \& Whitney Canada et d’avoir un impact concret sur l’atteinte des résultats.

Cette fonction polyvalente vous permettra de travailler sur de nombreux aspects d’un programme, allant de la définition d’une stratégie à long terme à la résolution de problèmes urgents. Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de **Longueuil** du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et **exclusivement en présentiel.**

Coordonner et prendre des décisions pour résoudre les problèmes d’approvisionnement.
* Négocier et collaborer avec les équipes Marketing, Ingénierie, Approvisionnement, Fabrication, MED (Manufacturing Engineering Development) et Après\-vente afin d’atteindre les exigences et obtenir l’adhésion aux stratégies et aux échéances de livraison.
* Fournir des rapports sur l’état d’avancement des programmes au gestionnaire OPM, aux directeurs et aux équipes marketing, accompagnés de recommandations. Escalader les problèmes au besoin afin d’assurer leur résolution. Soutenir la direction dans la communication des enjeux opérationnels avec les clients.
* Mettre en œuvre de manière proactive les stratégies d’approvisionnement des nouveaux programmes et les objectifs FSC, tout en explorant des alternatives avec des analyses de rentabilité solides.
* Définir les stratégies d’outillage et les études de rentabilité pour les programmes assignés, et exécuter les dépenses conformément aux budgets alloués à l’ingénierie et au démarrage.

* Une expérience au sein d’une unité d’affaires des opérations ou de la chaîne d’approvisionnement de P\&WC est un atout.
* Connaissance des systèmes SAP et PLM.
* Capacité à résoudre des problèmes complexes, communiquer de manière claire et diriger des projets.
